records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Ridge Systems!
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for setting up Ridge Systems on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Following up after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Glad we got your pagination question sorted — list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call. That ticket is now closed, but if anything about it is still unclear, just say the word.

After our kickoff, the natural next step is your first project — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. A teammate can also be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
